title: On the Genericity of the Spectrum Intervalization for Multi-Frequency Quasiperiodic Schrödinger Operators
summary: This paper proves a genericity conjecture by Goldstein, Schlag, and Voda[Invent. Math.\textbf{217}(2019)] for multi-frequency quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators. Specifically, we show that for almost all coefficients of real trigonometric polynomial potentials, the spectrum forms a single interval under strong coupling conditions. This confirms a long-standing intuition by Chulaevky and Sinai[Comm.Math.Phys.\textbf{125}(1989)] that the spectrum typically intervals for generic potentials, and extends the existence results of Goldstein et al. to a full measure setting.
